name: Audio Output Recorder
author: Brett
description: The recordings the paired phone makes of what it plays (Phone Connect records them; the mic only as an opt-in second track, Record my mic too, off by default), in timestamped 30-minute chunks on axHub. The recordings list (play, download, delete) shows on the console. Every part is transcribed on the VPS, with no model tokens, and saved with its session; transcripts are searchable.
